description: This file defines API route handlers for managing meetings in an employee management system. It sets up routes for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting meetings, as well as managing participant responses and providing ICS download functionality, with embedded Swagger documentation for API specification.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new meeting, expects meeting details and participants.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET request to list meetings, optionally filtered by query parameters.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific meeting by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates details of an existing meeting identified by ID.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Allows a participant to set their response (such as accepted or declined) for a meeting.

methods.name: getIcs
methods.description: Provides an ICS file for calendar integration of a particular meeting.
